        * Reapply to become accepted as official GNU project; requirements to be fulfilled:

              --> really? This will grow it up to 500 MB in size due to the images
            - Write an actual manual that is updated as necessary to reflect the current state of cybop;
            - Give a brief overview which documents should be read first if someone was trying to use the system

        * Try out CMake 3.1 with GUI as tool for build system
        * "Each subdirectory added by the command must also contain a CMakeLists.txt file as the entry point to that directory."
            Really? Each subdir? Not good!
        * Do NOT use it for in-source, but rather for OUT-OF-SOURCE builds (builddir != sourcedir)
        * Remove automake scripts afterwards
        * Use "CPack" tool to create installers as: executable installer (for Windows using "NSIS" tool), rpm, deb, tar, tar.gz, self-extracting tar file

        * Provide Debian package

CYBOI
_____

        * Compile cyboi for win32 using native visual studio, since mingw troubles with some functionality
        * See directory "doc/development/win32_visual_studio_migration/"

        * Compile cyboi on Mac OSX Darwin
        * See directory "doc/development/osx/"
        * Add gui functionality using "cocoa" environment (possibly requires objective c code to wrap the C application)
            https://developer.apple.com/library/mac/documentation/porting/conceptual/portingunix/environments/environments.html#//apple_ref/doc/uid/TP40002852-BBCIFCFH
            Carbon framework doesn't support X64 and is deprecated since Oktober 2012;
            X11 library is needed to install on mac but not supported by Apple anymore

        * Compile cyboi on ARM processor (Raspberry Pi)

        * Make cyboi usable on mobile devices, e.g. Android (Java), iOS (Objective-C)

        * Provide all possible attributes of serial interface RS-232 and console/terminal as cybol property

        * Factor out parts of cyboi (e.g. x-window-system) into dynamic libraries, to improve portability
        * Adapt automake script accordingly
        * Minimise cyboi size for usage in embedded systems

        * Implement given unix shell script "clean_result_directory.sh" in cybol
        * Add more options to "find file", so that the shell script can be executed
        * Provide more shell commands in a platform-independent way, usable on posix and win32
        * See overview in table "shell.ods"
        * Check why "display_content" example doesn't quite work right - parameter is not being found
        * Check why "change_directory" example also has problems
        * Start with simple DOS shell commands, e.g. "clear", and test in classical DOS command window
        * Add a couple of PowerShell commands and test in PowerShell
        * Implement these commands for UNIX shell as well, if existent
        * Rule of distinction between DOS and PowerShell: implement in classical DOS if command exists there; implement for PowerShell only if not existent for classical DOS
        * See list of commands:
            http://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix-Kommandos#Kommandos_.28Auswahl.29
            http://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Windows_PowerShell#Cmdlets
        * Create useful and uniform names for commands using pattern "verb-noun"
        * Procedure to add a new cybol operation to cyboi:
            * Write cybol example application using shell command (in order to identify an operation name as well as necessary properties)
            * Add shell commands to directory "constant/model/command/" (NOT necessary for standard cybol operations)
              -> go here to change names (if different for Unix/Win32)
            * Add commands to file "constant/format/cybol/logic/command_logic_cybol_format.c"
            * Add commands to file "constant/format/cyboi/logic_cyboi_format.c"
            * Add new file with options for each command to directory "constant/name/cybol/logic/commander/"
              -> ALL options regardless of OS
            * Add new file with options for each command to directory "constant/name/command_option/unix/" (or windows/) (NOT necessary for standard cybol operations)
            * Add commands to file "executor/representer/deserialiser/cybol/format_cybol_deserialiser.c"
              -> check file from step number 3
            * Add commands to file "executor/representer/serialiser/cybol/format_cybol_serialiser.c"
            * Add new file for each new command to directory "executor/commander/" (see example file "list_directory_contents_commander.c")
              -> check file from step number 2 for name of command, file from number 5 or number 6 for names of options
            * Consider platform (unix or windows) using preprocessor defines
            * Add new file for each command (cybol operation) to directory "applicator/command/"
              -> remove_file.c is a good example for this - has parameter and options
            * Add commands to section with comment "command" in file "controller/handler/operation_handler.c"

        * Implement standard algorithms for search, sort etc.

        * Add calculator functions for types datetime, duration
        * Add comparator functions for types datetime, duration

        * Continue decoder and encoder in directory "executor/converter/"
        * Implement additional character encodings "IBM-Code" and "7-Bit-Code" (see LDT standard, version 2012-06-18, page 22)
        * Add constants to new files in directory "constant/model/character_code/windows/"
        * Add constants to new files in directory "constant/model/character_code/dos/"
        * Factor out unicode characters into separate files oriented on code blocks
        * Add constants to new files in directory "constant/model/character_code/unicode/"
        * Simplify string constants using double quotes instead of apostrophed characters in an array, e.g.:
            static wchar_t* ID_0_FIELD_DESCRIPTION_XDT_MODEL = L"Unbekannte Feldkennung";
            static int* ID_0_FIELD_DESCRIPTION_XDT_MODEL_COUNT = NUMBER_22_INTEGER_STATE_CYBOI_MODEL_ARRAY;
        * Write short cybol application for testing
        * Test conversion using differently encoded text files

        * Create test functions in files of directory "tester/"
        * Adapt the following files only if new test files are introduced
            "constant/model/cyboi/option/test_unit_option_cyboi_model.c"
            "constant/model/cyboi/test/unit_test_cyboi_model.c"
            "executor/searcher/selector/command_line/test_unit_command_line_selector.c"
            "controller/tester.c"
        * Process test functions with e.g. "cyboi --test=calculator"
        * Let them produce an "OK" or "ERROR", in the style of JUnit

        * Create different layout manager algorithms for positioning of graphical components (arithmetics, similar to Swing and Qt)
        * Provide graphical standard components (geometry, similar to Swing), e.g. "button", chosen via "component" property in cybol
        * Create cybol template, e.g. login- or file open/save dialogue

        * Investigate and possibly implement IrDA socket
        * Investigate and possibly implement Bluetooth socket

        * Create css serialiser (and, optionally, deserialiser)
        * Prepare ldap communication (investigate protocol structure)
        * Create latex serialiser
